title: 📖 Reading Comprehension
description: Practice reading a simple story in Sanskrit.

sections.title: 📖 A Simple Story
sections.content: Read this story about a boy and his teacher:

story.sanskrit: एकः बालकः आसीत्। तस्य नाम रामः। रामः गुरुं गच्छति। गुरुः रामं पाठयति। रामः पठति। एकदा रामः पुस्तकं पश्यति। पुस्तकम् रोचते। रामः पुस्तकं पठति। गुरुः प्रसन्नः भवति।
story.translation: There was a boy. His name was Rama. Rama goes to the teacher. The teacher teaches Rama. Rama reads. One day Rama sees a book. He likes the book. Rama reads the book. The teacher becomes happy.

questions.question: What did Rama see one day?
questions.explanation: 'एकदा रामः पुस्तकं पश्यति।' means 'One day Rama saw a book.'

questions.question: How did the teacher feel at the end?
questions.explanation: 'गुरुः प्रसन्नः भवति।' means 'The teacher becomes happy.'
